summary: #1680 probe: H3-Image edit from three references on mps, pre-quantized int8 folders loaded one component at a time.
description: Stage A of #1680 (#1729), edit arm. Same two-step split as h3-image-mps-t2i.json: step 'encode' loads only the text encoder (with tokenizer and processor) from the pre-quantized folder /Users/don/diffusers-workspace/bench/assets/h3-prequantized-int8/text_encoder, removes lm_head, truncates the language model to 51 layers, runs before_encode and text_encoder on the prompt and the three references, returns prompt_embeds and text_token_tags, and is released. Step 'generate' loads the transformer from the int8 folder plus the VAE, scheduler and image_processor from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image, runs vae_encoder (the references' latents), denoise and decode, and saves one PNG under final. 'images' holds three references the prompt names as <Picture 1>..<Picture 3>: cast/estela.jpg and cast/aurelio.jpg (the lem edit arm's portraits) and bench/runner.png as the scene still (lem's parhelion/kf-open.png is not on mini-ai). No quantization_config is passed: sdnq reads each folder's own. Host-specific: stays in bench, never the catalog. Untested on mini-ai: its arm was skipped under the stage's time stop (#1744).

variables.prompt: The woman from <Picture 1> and the man from <Picture 2> stand side by side in the setting shown in <Picture 3>, looking toward the camera. Keep each face, hairstyle and build exactly as in their portraits; keep the setting, its light and its colour grade exactly as in <Picture 3>. Photographic, natural skin texture, medium two-shot at eye level, both faces clearly visible.
